name: Tavexia Lifecare Limited
about: Tavexia Lifecare Limited engages in manufacturing and trading of burners in India. The company is involved in manufacturing, supply, retail, and wholesale of Kapoor Dani, burner, aroma burner, ceramic Kapoor Dani, aroma oil burner and aroma oil burner cum night lamp, and night lamps, as well as home and office decoration lighting products, flowerpots with lighting, lighting flower vase, and aroma burner with timer. It sells its products through outlets and online selling platforms portals, such as India Mart, Amazon, Flipkart, Snapdeal, etc. The company was formerly known as Sattva Sukun Lifecare Limited and changed its name to Tavexia Lifecare Limited in August 2026. Tavexia Lifecare Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Mumbai, India.
